blurb: Artifex Brewing Company produces award-winning craft beer and offers tasting room experiences in San Clemente and Oceanside. Guests can visit their locations to sample a variety of beers and enjoy a community atmosphere near the beach and local shops. Merchandise such as branded apparel is also available for purchase.
